title: 1986's "Wisdom" which was the directorial debut of Emilio Estevez

commenti.body:
Pretty good film with an absolutely *horrible-no-good-terrible-annoying* end.

I suspect that's the reason why so many critics at the time (and I certainly agreed with them) hated the film when it was originally released.

I wound up catching it on HBO way, *waaaaaayyyyy* back when it originally aired and when the movie got to its end, I had to keep myself from throwing something at the TV!

So, yeah, I didn't like the film and the blame lies squarely in its conclusion.
